senses.en: a system of government with a king or queen as head of state
a country ruled by a king or queen

ex.en: The United Kingdom is a constitutional monarchy.
ex.zh: 英國是君主立憲國家。

senses.en: a building where monks live and worship

ex.en: The monastery sits high in the mountains, far from any town.
ex.zh: 那座修道院高踞山中，遠離任何城鎮。

root.note: 獨居修行之處 → 修道院

senses.en: relating to money or currency

ex.en: The central bank sets the country's monetary policy.
ex.zh: 中央銀行負責制定國家的貨幣政策。

parts.m: money 錢（源自羅馬鑄幣所在的朱諾神廟 Moneta）

senses.en: a dog of no definite breed
of mixed origin or character

ex.en: They adopted a friendly mongrel from the animal shelter.
ex.zh: 他們從收容所領養了一隻親人的米克斯。

senses.en: a warning of danger; a formal notice

ex.en: The dark clouds were a monition of the coming storm.
ex.zh: 烏雲是暴風雨即將來臨的警訊。

senses.en: giving a warning

ex.en: The principal sent a monitory letter to students who skipped class.
ex.zh: 校長寄了一封警告信給翹課的學生。

senses.en: government by a single person

ex.en: Without checks and balances, the republic slowly became a monocracy.
ex.zh: 缺乏制衡機制，這個共和國漸漸變成一人統治。

senses.en: the practice of having only one spouse or partner at a time

ex.en: Some bird species practice lifelong monogamy.
ex.zh: 有些鳥類終身實行單一配偶制。

root.note: 只有一段婚姻 → 一夫一妻

senses.en: a design of combined initials of a name, used on clothing or stationery

ex.en: Her towels were embroidered with a gold monogram.
ex.zh: 她的毛巾繡著金色的姓名縮寫圖案。

senses.en: a detailed written study of a single specialized subject

ex.en: The historian published a monograph on tea farming in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 這位歷史學家出版了一本關於台灣茶業的專著。

root.note: 只寫一個主題 → 專題論文

senses.en: a large single upright block of stone
a large, powerful organization that acts as a single unit and resists change

ex.en: An ancient monolith stands alone in the middle of the field.
ex.zh: 一根古老的巨石柱孤立在田野中央。

senses.en: a long speech by one actor or person

ex.en: The actor delivered a moving monologue at the end of the play.
ex.zh: 那位演員在劇末發表了一段動人的獨白。

senses.en: an obsessive focus on a single subject or idea

ex.en: Captain Ahab's monomania drives him to hunt the white whale at any cost.
ex.zh: 亞哈船長的偏執驅使他不惜一切代價獵捕白鯨。

root.note: 只對一件事瘋狂 → 偏執

senses.en: complete control of the supply of a product or service by one company
exclusive possession or control of something

ex.en: For decades the company held a monopoly on the city's electricity.
ex.zh: 幾十年來，這家公司壟斷了該市的電力供應。

root.note: 只有一家在賣 → 壟斷

senses.en: a word of one syllable

ex.en: The sulky teenager answered every question with a monosyllable.
ex.zh: 那個鬧脾氣的青少年每個問題都只回答一個字。

senses.en: a voice or sound that does not change in pitch
without variation in tone or color

ex.en: The lecturer spoke in a dull monotone that put everyone to sleep.
ex.zh: 講者用單調平板的語調說話，讓大家都睡著了。

senses.en: dull and boring because it never changes
senses.zh: 單調乏味的；一成不變的

ex.en: Working on an assembly line can be monotonous.
ex.zh: 在生產線上工作可能很單調乏味。

root.note: 只有一個音調的 → 單調的

senses.en: lack of variety; boring sameness

ex.en: A weekend trip helped break the monotony of her daily routine.
ex.zh: 一趟週末旅行幫她打破了日常生活的單調。

senses.en: a French title or form of address for a man, equivalent to Mr. or sir

ex.en: "Good evening, monsieur," said the waiter with a small bow.
ex.zh: 「晚安，先生。」服務生微微鞠躬說道。

senses.en: something very large and ugly, especially a building
senses.zh: 醜陋的龐然大物（尤指建築）

senses.en: something shockingly evil or wrong

ex.en: Residents called the new concrete tower a monstrosity.
ex.zh: 居民們把那棟新的水泥大樓稱為醜陋的怪物。

senses.en: a ray of moonlight

ex.en: A single moonbeam shone through the gap in the curtains.
ex.zh: 一道月光從窗簾的縫隙中灑了進來。

senses.en: the confidence and enthusiasm of a person or group

ex.en: Losing five games in a row hurt the team's morale.
ex.zh: 連輸五場比賽打擊了球隊的士氣。

root.note: 精神上的狀態 → 士氣

mn: morale [məˋræl]（士氣）重音在後；moral [ˋmɔrəl]（道德的）重音在前。

senses.en: a person who teaches or judges others' morals, often too strictly

ex.en: The moralist complained that modern music was corrupting young people.
ex.zh: 那位衛道人士抱怨現代音樂正在帶壞年輕人。

senses.en: principles about right and wrong behavior
the extent to which an action is right or wrong

ex.en: The novel raises questions about the morality of war.
ex.zh: 這部小說提出了關於戰爭道德性的問題。

senses.en: to comment on right and wrong, usually in a self-righteous way

ex.en: Please just help me and don't moralize about my mistakes.
ex.zh: 拜託幫我就好，別對我的錯誤說教。

senses.en: a temporary ban or suspension of an activity
a legal delay in paying debts

ex.en: The government declared a moratorium on new coal plants.
ex.zh: 政府宣布暫停興建新的燃煤電廠。

senses.en: having an unhealthy interest in death or disturbing subjects
senses.zh: 病態的；（對死亡等）有不健康興趣的

senses.en: (medicine) relating to disease

ex.en: He has a morbid fascination with plane crashes.
ex.zh: 他對空難有一種病態的著迷。

senses.en: biting or sarcastic in style or manner

ex.en: The columnist was feared for her mordacious wit.
ex.zh: 那位專欄作家以尖酸刻薄的機智令人畏懼。

root.note: 愛咬人的 → 尖酸刻薄

senses.en: (of humor) sharply sarcastic
a substance used to fix dyes in cloth

ex.en: The comedian is known for his mordant humor about politics.
ex.zh: 這位喜劇演員以對政治的辛辣幽默聞名。

senses.en: at the point of death; (of a thing) losing strength and close to ending
senses.zh: 垂死的；瀕臨消亡的；停滯的

ex.en: The new mayor promised to revive the town's moribund economy.
ex.zh: 新市長承諾要振興鎮上奄奄一息的經濟。

senses.en: sullen, gloomy, and unwilling to talk

ex.en: He became morose and withdrawn after losing his job.
ex.zh: 失業後，他變得悶悶不樂又孤僻。

root.note: 原指固執於習性 → 陰鬱

senses.en: the study of the form and structure of living things
the study of the forms of words

ex.en: Word morphology explains how "unhappiness" is built from smaller parts.
ex.zh: 構詞學解釋了 unhappiness 是如何由較小的部分組成的。

senses.en: made up of very different and mismatched kinds
senses.zh: 雜七雜八的；形形色色的

senses.en: the multicolored costume of a jester

ex.en: A motley crew of students, retirees, and artists joined the protest.
ex.zh: 學生、退休人士和藝術家等形形色色的人加入了抗議。

senses.en: a short phrase expressing a belief or guiding principle

ex.en: Our school motto is "Honesty, Diligence, Kindness."
ex.zh: 我們的校訓是「誠實、勤奮、仁慈」。

senses.en: a person who climbs mountains

ex.en: The experienced mountaineer reached the summit of Everest twice.
ex.zh: 這位經驗豐富的登山家兩度登上聖母峰。

senses.en: having many mountains
extremely large

ex.en: Taiwan is a mountainous island with more than two hundred peaks over 3,000 meters.
ex.zh: 台灣是一座多山的島嶼，超過三千公尺的山峰有兩百多座。

senses.en: the amount of food or drink that fills the mouth
(informal) a long word or phrase that is hard to say

ex.en: "Antidisestablishmentarianism" is quite a mouthful.
ex.zh: 「antidisestablishmentarianism」這個字真是又長又難唸。

senses.en: to confuse or mix things up
a state of confusion or disorder

ex.en: Too many instructions will only muddle the new employees.
ex.zh: 太多的指示只會把新員工搞糊塗。

mn: 片語 muddle through：勉強應付過去。

senses.en: to make a sound quieter or less clear
to wrap up for warmth

ex.en: Thick curtains help muffle the noise from the street.
ex.zh: 厚窗簾有助於減弱街上的噪音。

senses.en: (dated, now offensive) a person with one Black and one white parent
senses.zh: （過時且帶冒犯意味）黑白混血兒

ex.en: Historians note that the word mulatto appeared in colonial census records.
ex.zh: 歷史學家指出，mulatto 這個詞曾出現在殖民時期的人口普查紀錄中。

parts.m: mule 騾子（西班牙文 mulo）

root.note: 源自「騾子」的比喻，因此被視為冒犯用語

mn: 這是帶有種族歧視色彩的舊詞，現代請用 mixed-race 或 biracial。

senses.en: a person who drives mules

ex.en: The muleteer led the pack animals down the narrow mountain trail.
ex.zh: 趕騾人牽著馱獸走下狹窄的山路。

senses.en: having many forms or shapes

ex.en: The artist explored the multiform beauty of clouds.
ex.zh: 這位藝術家探索雲朵千變萬化的美。

senses.en: a large number or variety

ex.en: The city offers a multiplicity of cultures, cuisines, and languages.
ex.zh: 這座城市擁有多元的文化、美食和語言。

senses.en: ordinary and dull; lacking interest
relating to this world rather than a spiritual one

ex.en: The novel turns a mundane trip to the grocery store into an adventure.
ex.zh: 這部小說把一趟平凡的超市購物寫成了一場冒險。

root.note: 世間的 → 世俗、平凡的

senses.en: relating to a city or town or its local government

ex.en: The municipal government built a new library downtown.
ex.zh: 市政府在市中心蓋了一座新圖書館。

root.note: 承擔公共職責的（城市）→ 市政的

senses.en: a city or town with its own local government
senses.zh: 自治市；直轄市；市政當局

ex.en: Taichung became a special municipality in 2010.
ex.zh: 台中在 2010 年升格為直轄市。

senses.en: great generosity in giving

ex.en: Thanks to one donor's munificence, the museum doubled its collection.
ex.zh: 多虧一位捐贈者的慷慨，博物館的館藏增加了一倍。

senses.en: extremely generous

ex.en: The university received a munificent gift of fifty million dollars.
ex.zh: 這所大學獲得了五千萬美元的慷慨捐贈。

senses.en: to gather up courage, strength, or support
to assemble troops for inspection or battle
a gathering of troops

ex.en: She finally managed to muster the courage to ask for a raise.
ex.zh: 她終於鼓起勇氣要求加薪。

root.note: 召集起來展示 → 集合

senses.en: a change in the genetic structure of an organism
a change or alteration

ex.en: A single mutation can make a virus spread more easily.
ex.zh: 單一突變就能讓病毒更容易傳播。

senses.en: to injure severely by cutting off or damaging part of the body
to damage or spoil something badly

ex.en: Careless editing can mutilate a good essay.
ex.zh: 粗心的編輯可能把一篇好文章改得面目全非。

senses.en: an open rebellion against authority, especially by sailors or soldiers
to refuse to obey authority; to rebel

ex.en: The sailors staged a mutiny and took control of the ship.
ex.zh: 水手們發動叛變，奪取了船隻的控制權。

senses.en: countless; extremely many
a very large number of things

ex.en: The internet offers myriad ways to learn a new language.
ex.zh: 網路提供了無數種學習新語言的方法。

parts.m: ten thousand 一萬（希臘文 myrias）

senses.en: a person who seeks spiritual truth through meditation or prayer
mystical; having spiritual or hidden meaning

ex.en: The mystic spent years meditating alone in a mountain cave.
ex.zh: 那位神祕主義者獨自在山洞中冥想多年。

root.note: 參與祕密儀式的人 → 神祕主義者

senses.en: a state of confusion or bewilderment
the act of making something unnecessarily obscure

ex.en: She stared at the strange instructions in complete mystification.
ex.zh: 她一頭霧水地盯著那些奇怪的說明。

senses.en: a traditional story explaining natural or social events, often involving gods
a widely held but false belief

ex.en: It is a myth that we only use ten percent of our brains.
ex.zh: 人類只用了百分之十的大腦是一種迷思。

senses.en: a collection of myths of a particular culture
the study of myths

ex.en: In Greek mythology, Zeus is the king of the gods.
ex.zh: 在希臘神話中，宙斯是眾神之王。

root.note: 神話故事的集合；神話學

senses.en: having no name or an unknown name
too terrible or hard to describe

ex.en: A nameless donor paid for the children's new playground.
ex.zh: 一位不具名的捐贈者出錢蓋了孩子們的新遊樂場。

senses.en: a flammable liquid obtained from petroleum or coal, used as fuel or solvent

ex.en: The refinery turns crude oil into naphtha and other products.
ex.zh: 煉油廠把原油加工成石腦油和其他產品。

senses.en: (Greek myth) a beautiful youth who fell in love with his own reflection
senses.zh: （希臘神話）納西瑟斯（愛上自己倒影的美少年）

senses.en: (lowercase) a plant with white or yellow flowers, such as the daffodil

ex.en: Like Narcissus, the singer seemed to be in love with his own image.
ex.zh: 那位歌手就像納西瑟斯一樣，似乎愛上了自己的形象。

mn: narcissism（自戀）就是從這個神話人物而來。

senses.en: to tell a story; to give a spoken commentary for a film or show

ex.en: A famous actor agreed to narrate the nature documentary.
ex.zh: 一位知名演員答應為這部自然紀錄片擔任旁白。

senses.en: the act of telling a story; a spoken commentary

ex.en: The film's narration is spoken by the main character as an old man.
ex.zh: 這部電影的旁白由年老時的主角來敘述。

senses.en: a spoken or written account of connected events; a story
a way of presenting events that reflects a particular point of view
in the form of a story

ex.en: The politician tried to change the narrative about the economy.
ex.zh: 那位政治人物試圖扭轉關於經濟的論述。

senses.en: a person who tells a story, especially in a book, play, or film

ex.en: The narrator of the novel turns out to be unreliable.
ex.zh: 這部小說的敘述者結果是不可靠的。

senses.en: unwilling to accept ideas or opinions different from one's own
senses.zh: 心胸狹窄的；思想偏狹的

ex.en: It is narrow-minded to judge people by their accents.
ex.zh: 以口音來評斷別人是很狹隘的。

senses.en: relating to the nose
(of a voice) sounding as if breathed through the nose

ex.en: This nasal spray relieves stuffiness caused by allergies.
ex.zh: 這種鼻噴劑可以緩解過敏造成的鼻塞。

senses.en: relating to the place or time of one's birth

ex.en: Salmon swim back to their natal streams to lay eggs.
ex.zh: 鮭魚會洄游到出生的溪流產卵。

mn: prenatal（產前的）、postnatal（產後的）都含這個字根。

senses.en: the status of belonging to a particular nation; citizenship
an ethnic group forming part of a nation

ex.en: Please write your nationality on the immigration form.
ex.zh: 請在入境表格上填寫你的國籍。

root.note: 出生所屬的國家 → 國籍

senses.en: in a normal or expected way; of course
by nature; without artificial help

ex.en: Some people are naturally good at languages.
ex.zh: 有些人天生就擅長語言。

senses.en: a feeling of sickness with an urge to vomit
strong disgust

ex.en: The medicine may cause mild nausea and headaches.
ex.zh: 這種藥可能引起輕微的噁心和頭痛。

senses.en: to make someone feel sick or disgusted

ex.en: The smell of rotting fish would nauseate anyone.
ex.zh: 腐魚的氣味會讓任何人作嘔。

senses.en: feeling sick and wanting to vomit
causing disgust; nauseating

ex.en: The winding mountain road made me feel nauseous.
ex.zh: 彎彎曲曲的山路讓我覺得想吐。

senses.en: relating to sailors, ships, or navigation

ex.en: One nautical mile is slightly longer than a regular mile.
ex.zh: 一海里比一般的英里稍長一點。

senses.en: relating to a navy or warships

ex.en: The naval base is located on the southern coast.
ex.zh: 海軍基地位於南部海岸。

mn: naval（海軍的）和 navel（肚臍）同音，別寫錯。

senses.en: the small hollow in the middle of the belly; the belly button
the central point of something

ex.en: A navel orange has a small bump at one end that looks like a belly button.
ex.zh: 臍橙的一端有個小凸起，看起來像肚臍。

mn: navel-gazing：過度自省、只顧自己的事。

senses.en: (of a river or sea) wide and deep enough for ships to travel on
(of a website) easy to move around in

ex.en: The river is navigable only during the rainy season.
ex.zh: 這條河只有在雨季才能通航。
